manifest.name: Card Color Tags
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Adds a colored left border to each card based on its first tag for quick visual categorization

css: .card-item[data-color-tag] { border-left: 4px solid var(--tag-color, #999) !important; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .color-tag-legend { position: fixed; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; z-index: 9998; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .color-tag-legend-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 0; } .color-tag-legend-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; flex-shrink: 0; } body.dark-theme .color-tag-legend { background: rgba(30,30,30,0.95); border-color: #444; color: #ccc; }
